missions.name: Act I: "Avaritia"
story: Greed has made a house of the old exchange.
Whatever it takes, it keeps. Take it back.

missions.name: Act I: "Gula"
story: The banquet hall has eaten the city's bread for a year.

missions.name: Act I: "Ira"
story: Wrath holds the east gate, and it burns hotter the more it bleeds.

missions.name: Bonus: "The Gorgon"
story: Bring me the head of Medusa...
...and such artifact never been seen will be yours!
